humanReview.verdict: rejected — agent self-scores were inflated; every category re-scored from the board against the turnaround

nostrike.scoringCaveat: faceExpressionRead was scored by the same agent that authored the face-atlas fix. Treat it as self-scored and re-check it first at the next human review.

frontProfileSilhouette.label: front/profile silhouette
frontProfileSilhouette.note: The large read matches the turnaround with no colour: headband, bun, hooked ponytail, crimson kit, pink knickers, red socks, white-soled shoes. The round-2 construction pass retired the cracked 'torn paper' trim edges and the capsule-segmented legs — surfaces are continuous and smooth-shaded in junebug-front-review.png. Held at 4: junebug-profile-review.png still shows a white ring at the shoulder with a dark interior (a 3.7 open-interior concern), and the forearms are thin tubes where the turnaround's are chunkier.

headBodyProportions.label: head/body proportions
headBodyProportions.note: Head-to-body ratio is a child's and the joints read as connected forms, both improvements. Still below 4 on head STRUCTURE: side by side at matched scale (scratch crops of the concept and junebug-front-review.png), the turnaround's skull is wider with full round cheeks and a short forehead, while the delivered head is longer and narrower, the brow-to-hairline gap is visibly taller than the concept's, and the temples pinch instead of carrying cheek width down to the jaw.

hairMass.label: hair mass
hairMass.note: One designed mass that reads from front and side: the headband sits at the hairline over a full crown with a bun above it, and the ponytail is a smooth tapered sweep into the concept's arrow tip. Held at 4 because 3.3's five requires SCULPTED strand grouping: the crown's strand read is painted highlight banding that reads as corduroy in junebug-front-review.png, the bun stacks as polygonal shelves, and the temple hair meets the face as a hard geometric wedge rather than the concept's soft taper.

clothingConstruction.label: clothing construction
clothingConstruction.note: The garments now read as constructed rather than primitive volumes: V-neck with white trim, a placket with round buttons, twin white stripes running the FULL sleeve length (the round-1 'claw marks' are gone), sleeve cuffs, knickers cuffed below the knee into long red socks, and layered shoes with soles, toe caps and sidewalls. Held at 4: the waist still stacks as jersey hem over a salmon band over pants where the turnaround has a red belt, and there are no belt loops or buckle.

faceExpressionRead.label: face/expression read
faceExpressionRead.note: SELF-SCORED — see scoringCaveat. The eyes were rebuilt to the concept's measured construction: a cream almond (#d1b294 sampled off the turnaround) carrying a large brown iris, pupil, single high catchlight and a weighted upper lid, sized by the one scale-invariant ratio (iris diameter over iris spacing: concept 0.305, delivered 0.333). The round-1/round-2 'black tadpole' and the cross-eyed convergence are both gone in junebug-front-review.png, and thick angular brows over a firm frown carry the determined read. Held at 4, not 5: ears still fail 3.10 (small nubs, no rim/inner shadow/lobe), the nose reads as a shadow smudge head-on, and the features are atlas-painted rather than integrated with the skull's planes.

heroAndFieldScale.label: hero + 40px read
heroAndFieldScale.note: Hero read is now genuinely good — junebug-runtime-hero.png reads as a determined kid in a crimson kit with headband and ponytail, and the eyes survive gameplay lighting for the first time. Still 3 on the field half: the board's 40 px strip (junebug-fidelity-review.png) resolves headband, jersey, pants and shoes as colour blocks, but the face collapses to a smudge and the hooked ponytail — her single most memorable mark — is invisible from the front, so identity only partially survives at gameplay distance.
